# pok

> pok is a file-based CLI framework for building beautiful command-line interfaces. It features file-based routing, Zod-powered type safety, interactive prompts, and parallel execution capabilities, designed to reduce developer friction and onboarding time.

## Documentation

- [Getting Started](https://github.com/djgrant/pok/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): How to install and create your first pok project
- [Architecture](https://github.com/djgrant/pok/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): Overview of the system architecture and design choices
- [CLI Flags](https://github.com/djgrant/pok/blob/main/docs/cli-flags.md): Reference for global CLI flags and options
- [Testing](https://github.com/djgrant/pok/blob/main/docs/testing.md): Guide to testing pok commands and applications
- [Terminal Requirements](https://github.com/djgrant/pok/blob/main/docs/terminal-requirements.md): Supported terminal capabilities and environments

## Concepts

- [Commands](https://github.com/djgrant/pok/blob/main/docs/concepts/commands.md): Defining and organizing CLI commands
- [Environments](https://github.com/djgrant/pok/blob/main/docs/concepts/environments.md): Managing execution environments and context
- [Tasks](https://github.com/djgrant/pok/blob/main/docs/concepts/tasks.md): Creating reusable, composable units of work
- [Checks](https://github.com/djgrant/pok/blob/main/docs/concepts/checks.md): Validation and pre-flight checks
- [Events](https://github.com/djgrant/pok/blob/main/docs/concepts/events.md): Event system for inter-component communication
- [Command History](https://github.com/djgrant/pok/blob/main/docs/concepts/history.md): Rerunning recent commands with `poks`
- [Dry Run](https://github.com/djgrant/pok/blob/main/docs/concepts/dry-run.md): Understanding and implementing dry-run modes
- [Structured Output](https://github.com/djgrant/pok/blob/main/docs/concepts/output.md): Typed command output with automatic format routing

## API Reference

- [runCli](https://github.com/djgrant/pok/blob/main/docs/api/router.md#runcli): Recommended entry point for production CLIs
- [defineCommand](https://github.com/djgrant/pok/blob/main/docs/api/define-command.md): API for defining new commands
- [defineTask](https://github.com/djgrant/pok/blob/main/docs/api/define-task.md): API for defining tasks
- [defineEnv](https://github.com/djgrant/pok/blob/main/docs/api/define-env.md): API for defining environments
- [Router](https://github.com/djgrant/pok/blob/main/docs/api/router.md): Routing system API (run, buildCommandTree)
- [Runner](https://github.com/djgrant/pok/blob/main/docs/api/runner.md): Task execution runner API
- [Tabs](https://github.com/djgrant/pok/blob/main/docs/api/tabs.md): Tabbed interface API
